newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to launch stock option plan in 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to launch stock option plan in 1997 - paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp plans to begin providing stock options to its employees by the end of this year following an expected revision of the commercial code in June to allow such compensation programmes, the Japanese financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday.
The company may offer options on several tens of thousands of shares a year to its board members and will probably extend the plan to include more junior employees in the future, the paper said.
A spokesman for Toyota said he could not immediately comment on the report.
Fujitsu Ltd said on Friday that it is also considering introducing a stock option programme as early as fiscal 1998/99, which starts in April 1998.
A Fujitsu spokesman said that 32 top executives and division chiefs just below the rank of director may be eligible for stock options.
